afd.snippet: 000 FXUS65 KBOU 231737 AFDBOU Area Forecast Discussion National Weather Service Denver/Boulder CO 1137 AM MDT Wed Sep 23 2026 .KEY MESSAGES... - A disturbance moves through Wednesday and Thursday bringing increased chances for showers/storms (40-70%) and cooler temperatures Thursday. - Drier and warmer this weekend, but isolated showers and thunderstorms each afternoon and evening can't be ruled o

fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION...Today through Sunday... Moisture will continue to increase for the area throughout the day. Scattered showers and thunderstorms will form over the higher terrain by late morning/early afternoon before pushing onto the plains. By the evening and through early Thursday, rain coverage and intensity should increase. The majority of the southern half of the area can expect wetting rains.
